ValidationRule.description: Validation to stop Creation of client sub plan history record when Change Order is in progress.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISNEW() && NSP_Start_Date__c = TODAY() && NSP_Asset__r.NSP_Process_Order_Change__c && NOT(ISPICKVAL(NSP_Asset__r.NSP_Change_Order_Process_Contract_Status__c,'Contract Closed')) && $User.NSP_Profile_Name__c <>'Data Migration'
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You Cannot Add Asset to New Plan as change order is in progress.
